fixes.title: God of War hit flash flicker / framebuffer feedback
symptoms: Screen flickers for several seconds when Kratos hits an enemy
Screen flickers when Kratos gets hit
The game otherwise runs smoothly on iPhone-class hardware

fallback_profile.backend: Software or most accurate renderer path if exposed

implementation_patch_plan: Detect the God of War title/serial and force an accurate framebuffer-feedback path while hit-flash post-processing is active.
Do not reuse a Metal texture as both the current render target and sampled texture without a barrier/fetch-safe resolve.
Preserve destination alpha during post-process passes instead of clearing or approximating it.
Invalidate cached render-target resolves after GS alpha-blend state changes that read from the previous frame buffer.
user_steps: Set renderer to Metal and internal resolution to Native 1x before testing the same fight again.
Enable high/accurate blending and accurate destination alpha if the settings UI exposes them.
If flicker remains, use the software/accurate fallback renderer for God of War until the Metal feedback path is patched.

fixes.title: Silent Hill 2 gameplay black screen after first cutscene
symptoms: Gameplay becomes a black screen after the cutscene
Audio or game state may continue while graphics are missing

safe_profile.texture_preloading: Full hash cache disabled for diagnosis
safe_profile.readbacks: Synchronous when effects sample the frame/depth buffer

fallback_profile.backend: Software or most accurate renderer path if exposed

implementation_patch_plan: Treat black gameplay with active audio as a GS render-target/depth/fog failure, not as a boot failure.
Add a Silent Hill 2 compatibility flag that disables unsafe CRC hacks and requires accurate depth/fog state for gameplay scenes.
Force a full target resolve before post-processing passes that sample the previous color or depth buffer.
user_steps: Start from an in-game save instead of a save state made during the cutscene.
Use Native 1x and disable widescreen/CRC/skipdraw hacks while testing the first playable scene.
If the scene is still black, switch to the software/accurate renderer path for the first playable scene, save, then retest Metal.

fixes.title: Scarface scrambled screen after boot
symptoms: Rendered screen is scrambled or unreadable
Changing scripts alone does not make the display correct

fallback_profile.backend: Software or most accurate renderer path if exposed

implementation_patch_plan: Flush or re-key texture-cache entries when the game aliases render targets as textures.
Resolve render targets before presentation when the source page has been written through an overlapping GS memory region.
Disable aggressive upscaling and half-pixel heuristics for this title until the scrambled presentation is fixed.
user_steps: Test at Native 1x with CRC hacks and custom shaders disabled.
Use high texture-cache precision and PS2 bilinear filtering.
If the image remains scrambled, use the software/accurate fallback renderer for this title.

fixes.title: Spinning models and broken geometry in Dark Cloud 2 / Odin Sphere
symptoms: The issue is visual but likely caused by VU transform accuracy

cpu_vu_requirements.clamping_mode: Extra+Preserve Sign if Normal still glitches

implementation_patch_plan: Route affected titles through a per-game VU-accuracy profile before trying renderer-only fixes.
Disable unsafe VU speedhacks for known transform bugs so Metal receives correct vertex data.
Expose the VU accuracy dependency in graphics diagnostics because the symptom appears as broken rendering.
user_steps: Switch VU0 and VU1 to Interpreter, then retest the same model/scene.
Keep Native 1x until geometry is stable, then raise resolution gradually.

fixes.title: Crash Twinsanity animation glitches and iPad aspect scaling
symptoms: Character animations behave unnaturally or glitch
Stretch to Window does not apply on iPad
The game is otherwise smooth and playable

safe_profile.aspect_ratio: Recompute viewport immediately after setting change

implementation_patch_plan: Invalidate the Metal viewport/scissor cache whenever aspect ratio changes on iPad.
Rebuild touch and drawable bounds in the same transaction so visual scaling and input remain aligned.
Apply a VU accuracy fallback when animation glitches reproduce independently of the iPad scaling bug.
user_steps: Set aspect ratio before launching the game, force-close, then relaunch in the desired iPad orientation.
If animation still glitches, disable MTVU/Instant VU1 and test VU interpreters.
Only increase internal resolution after viewport scaling and animation are both stable.
